Frequently asked questions on the top online training solutions

What is the best training software for employees?

The best employee training software depends on your goals and team size. Absorb LMS is a standout if you need a scalable, AI-powered LMS. It supports everything from compliance training to personalized learning paths with automation that saves time.

Look for key features like:

Easy course creation

Robust reporting and analytics

Mobile, cloud-based access

Role-based content delivery

Comprehensive knowledge base

The right online training software makes learning simple, effective, and measurable.

Which is the best employee management software?

If you're focused on managing employee growth and development, pairing your HR tools with a capable LMS can make a big difference. Platforms like Absorb integrate with popular HR systems and help connect training with performance goals.

It’s less about replacing HR software and more about complementing it with meaningful learning insights.

Which is the best training platform?

The best training platform adapts to your organization’s needs, whether it's onboarding, compliance, or developing new training programs. Solutions like Absorb are often chosen for their flexibility and ability to support a variety of formats and learning styles.

Prioritize collaborative and role-based learning, scalable design, and tools that support both admins and learners.

What is the best training for employees?

The most effective employee training programs clearly connect to job roles and business outcomes. And that depends entirely on your company’s goals. This might involve building structured learning paths to develop talent or offering microlearning for in-the-moment training. Determine your learning goals, then choose your employee training.

Ready to find effective training solutions?

The right employee training system can do more than just check the compliance box (though that’s important too). It helps your teams grow, stay engaged, and actually enjoy learning.

Whether you’re after ease of use, advanced features, or a bit of both, each platform on this list brings something different to the table. And if you’re looking for training software that grows with you and supports every stage of the employee journey, Absorb is a great place to start.

Whatever you choose, investing in a smarter way to train is always a good move.

Top 15 employee training platforms

You could spend hours comparing learning management system (LMS) options. Or, you could start here to find the best employee training software.

If you’re searching for the best employee training system for your team, you’ve likely been met with endless tabs, vague promises, and more than one “free demo” form. We’ve been there. That’s why we built this guide.

Below, you’ll find 15 top picks for employee training software, each with clear details on what they do well, who they’re best for, and how they can support your team. Whether you need an intuitive online training software for small teams or a robust platform to train thousands, there’s something here for you.

Let’s help you narrow down the best LMS for employee training.

Top 15 employee training platforms

Now it’s time to get specific. Here are the top training platforms worth your attention, each one built to help teams learn better, faster, and with less friction.

1. Absorb LMS

‎‎

G2 rating: 4.6 out of 5 (644 reviews)

Absorb LMS helps you deliver training that doesn’t just tick the box. It actually makes an impact.

From first-day onboarding to long-term career development, Absorb is designed for every stage of the employee journey. All within a clean, intuitive interface your admin and learners will enjoy.

Why we like it:

Smart automation: Free up L&D teams with automated enrollments, reminders, and certifications.

AI-powered tools: Use course authoring for faster content creation and AI-driven upskilling to guide learners with personalized learning paths.

Scalable design: Whether you're training 50 or 50,000 employees, Absorb scales with you. No IT headaches included (phew).

Social learning: Lean into mentorship, user-generated content, and games so employees can learn from peers and build a collaborative learning culture.

In-office, remote, or hybrid, Absorb makes learning easy to roll out, track, and optimize. The platform also supports compliance training, onboarding, upskilling, and everything in between, so you can spend less time managing training and more time watching your teams grow.

2. Litmos

‎

G2 rating: 4.3 out of 5 (630 reviews)

Litmos helps organizations move fast. Whether you’re training frontline employees, delivering compliance courses, or rolling out customer service skills across a global team, Litmos lets you do it all from one place.

But what really sets Litmos apart is its fast implementation and interactive tools.

Why we like it:

Built-in content authoring: Designed with an internal content creator, your team can build online courses without extensive training.

Quick deployment: Get up and running fast using tools and navigation.

Collaborative experience: Includes discussion forums, social sharing, and gamification features to keep learners engaged.

Litmos is ideal for organizations that need a flexible, off-the-shelf solution that still offers room to grow and customize.

3. Talent LMS

‎ ‎

G2 rating: 4.6 out of 5 (779 reviews)

From easy-to-use training tools that make engagement and progress tracking a breeze, TalentLMS delivers what teams need (without overengineering it).

Why we like it:

Automates repetitive work: Set up rules to assign training, send reminders, and grade tests.

Simple interface: Easy to navigate for educating and training management, so you can focus on learning, not troubleshooting.

Learner progress tracking: Monitor engagement and course completions at a glance with built-in dashboards.

TalentLMS is a smart choice for small to mid-sized businesses that want to train employees without backend work or IT support. It gives your team everything they need to learn while keeping things simple for the admin behind the scenes.

Engaging learner experience: Designed to keep employees motivated with a clean interface and user-friendly learning paths.

LearnUpon is a strong fit for organizations that need a flexible, all-in-one LMS without sacrificing simplicity.

Prioritize collaborative and role-based learning, scalable design, and tools that support both admins and learners.

What is the best training for employees?

The most effective employee training programs clearly connect to job roles and business outcomes. And that depends entirely on your company’s goals. This might involve building structured learning paths to develop talent or offering microlearning for in-the-moment training. Determine your learning goals, then choose your employee training.

Ready to find effective training solutions?

The right employee training system can do more than just check the compliance box (though that’s important too). It helps your teams grow, stay engaged, and actually enjoy learning.

Whether you’re after ease of use, advanced features, or a bit of both, each platform on this list brings something different to the table. And if you’re looking for training software that grows with you and supports every stage of the employee journey, Absorb is a great place to start.

Whatever you choose, investing in a smarter way to train is always a good move.

text
Go live with EDI partners in days, not months. Orderful’s Full-Service EDI solution offers a one-time integration that enables logistics companies to quickly integrate and go live with new trading partners in 9 days or less.

Why Orderful

End-to-End Order-to-Cash Automation Made Easy

Orderful simplifies your Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle by automating key steps from receiving orders to getting paid. With fast integration to our expansive EDI network, we make O2C efficient and error-free while you stay in full control.

What is Order-to-Cash?

Breaking Down the Order-to-Cash Process

The Order-to-Cash process includes every action from receiving a customer order to final payment. Orderful’s O2C solution digitizes and automates this workflow, replacing manual steps with efficient, error-free EDI transactions. Our platform handles order confirmations, shipping updates, invoicing, and payment, reducing delays and supporting consistent cash flow.

Screenshot 2025-02-03 at 3.41.11 PM.png

How EDI Improves Order-to-Cash

Speed Up Payments and Minimize Errors with EDI

With Orderful, every stage of O2C becomes faster and more accurate. When a customer places an order, EDI documents like the EDI 850 (Purchase Order) and EDI 810 (Invoice) move efficiently through our platform, reducing the risk of human error and improving processing speed. Automated matching and real-time updates ensure that orders proceed smoothly, keeping customers satisfied and payments punctual.

Why Choose Orderful’s Order-to-Cash Solution?

Reliable Performance for Better Cash Flow and Productivity

Orderful’s O2C solution is ideal for businesses needing a dependable, scalable way to manage high transaction volumes. Key benefits include:

Automated Processes – Reduces manual tasks by using EDI exchanges that cut down on delays and increase processing efficiency.

Single Integration to Access a Broad Network – Integrate once and access thousands of partners without individual setups, saving you time and resources.

Real-Time Order Visibility – Monitor every transaction with live tracking and reporting, so you’re always in the loop.

Speed to Go-Live – Get set up fast with Orderful’s flexible platform and comprehensive support, allowing for a swift go-live and faster time-to-cash.

Key EDI Transactions for O2C Success

Essential EDI Documents in the Orderful O2C Workflow

Orderful’s platform includes automated support for critical EDI transactions that drive the Order-to-Cash process:

EDI 850 Purchase Order: Starts the order process with important details.

EDI 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgment: Confirms receipt and alignment on order details.

EDI 856 Advanced Shipping Notice: Provides shipping updates before arrival.

EDI 810 Invoice: Requests payment to help expedite collections.

EDI 820 Payment Order: Confirms payment intent and details, minimizing processing times.

Ready to Simplify Your Order-to-Cash Process?

Ready to Simplify Your Order-to-Cash Process?

Orderful’s O2C solution lets you automate, scale, and improve cash flow effortlessly. Get started with Orderful’s expert-led EDI solution to make Order-to-Cash simple, so you can focus on growth.

text
Order-to-Cash

Simplify Your Order-to-Cash Process with Orderful

Go live with EDI partners in days, not months. Orderful’s Full-Service EDI solution offers a one-time integration that enables logistics companies to quickly integrate and go live with new trading partners in 9 days or less.

Why Orderful

End-to-End Order-to-Cash Automation Made Easy

Orderful simplifies your Order-to-Cash (O2C) cycle by automating key steps from receiving orders to getting paid. With fast integration to our expansive EDI network, we make O2C efficient and error-free while you stay in full control.

What is Order-to-Cash?

Breaking Down the Order-to-Cash Process

The Order-to-Cash process includes every action from receiving a customer order to final payment. Orderful’s O2C solution digitizes and automates this workflow, replacing manual steps with efficient, error-free EDI transactions. Our platform handles order confirmations, shipping updates, invoicing, and payment, reducing delays and supporting consistent cash flow.

How EDI Improves Order-to-Cash

Speed Up Payments and Minimize Errors with EDI

With Orderful, every stage of O2C becomes faster and more accurate. When a customer places an order, EDI documents like the EDI 850 (Purchase Order) and EDI 810 (Invoice) move efficiently through our platform, reducing the risk of human error and improving processing speed. Automated matching and real-time updates ensure that orders proceed smoothly, keeping customers satisfied and payments punctual.

Why Choose Orderful’s Order-to-Cash Solution?

Reliable Performance for Better Cash Flow and Productivity

Orderful’s O2C solution is ideal for businesses needing a dependable, scalable way to manage high transaction volumes. Key benefits include:

Automated Processes – Reduces manual tasks by using EDI exchanges that cut down on delays and increase processing efficiency.

Single Integration to Access a Broad Network – Integrate once and access thousands of partners without individual setups, saving you time and resources.

Real-Time Order Visibility – Monitor every transaction with live tracking and reporting, so you’re always in the loop.

Speed to Go-Live – Get set up fast with Orderful’s flexible platform and comprehensive support, allowing for a swift go-live and faster time-to-cash.

Key EDI Transactions for O2C Success

Essential EDI Documents in the Orderful O2C Workflow

Orderful’s platform includes automated support for critical EDI transactions that drive the Order-to-Cash process:

EDI 850 Purchase Order: Starts the order process with important details.

EDI 855 Purchase Order Acknowledgment: Confirms receipt and alignment on order details.

EDI 856 Advanced Shipping Notice: Provides shipping updates before arrival.

EDI 810 Invoice: Requests payment to help expedite collections.

EDI 820 Payment Order: Confirms payment intent and details, minimizing processing times.

Ready to Simplify Your Order-to-Cash Process?

Ready to Simplify Your Order-to-Cash Process?

Orderful’s O2C solution lets you automate, scale, and improve cash flow effortlessly. Get started with Orderful’s expert-led EDI solution to make Order-to-Cash simple, so you can focus on growth.

Schedule a Call

Table of contents Back to top Semrush Personal Keyword Metrics Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization (AIO) Ahrefs Keyword Explorer Exploding Topics RankIQ SurferSEO Jasper Alli AI ChatGPT Key features of top AI tools Why Is AI Useful for Marketers? How to use AI for SEO, writing, ideation, and more Essential AI optimization tools for digital marketers Conclusion Blog > 9 Top AI SEO Tools I Recommend in 2025 9 Top AI SEO Tools I Recommend in 2025 by Deb Dutta Last Updated: October 3, 2025 Contents: Share: AI tools offer a lot of value for SEO professionals in many ways. You can use AI to tackle: Content optimization and updates Content decay and technical SEO audits Competitor research Brand reputation monitoring in LLM search Let's take a look at some AI SEO tools I, personally, find very useful as a writer and SEO specialist. Top AI SEO Tool Best For Strength Price (Starting) Free Trial Semrush Personal Keyword Metrics Keyword research AI-powered personalized keyword difficulty score & advanced keyword database $139.95/month 7-day free trial Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization Enterprise-level AI monitoring Analyze presence in LLM search: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude $99/month plus Semrush subscription None Ahrefs Keyword Explorer Search intent & SERP analysis Search intent classification + detailed keyword insights with AI $129/month None Exploding Topics Trend discovery Discover emerging topic trends before they're detected by other tools $39/month (billed annually) 7-day free trial RankIQ Niche blogging Access a curated database of low-competition keywords $49/month None SurferSEO Content marketers Generate and optimize content with AI $79/month None Jasper Marketing teams Generate content with a consistent brand voice $39/month per seat 7-day free trial Alli AI Technical SEO Automated site-wide technical SEO fixes $169/month 10 days ChatGPT General SEO Assistance Content ideation, clustering, and SEO data analysis with AI $20/month (Pro Plan) Free plan available Contents: ...more 1. Semrush Personal Keyword Metrics Semrush is the primary SEO tool I (along with my Exploding Topics teammates) use for SEO analysis, including keywords and topic research. Enter a keyword into the Keyword Overview Tool and it will show you key data about your keyword such as volume, difficulty, and intent. Any half decent keyword research tool will show you this information, so Semrush isn't unique in that. But when it comes to the number of keyword ideas it shows, Semrush usually surpasses other tools: it uses AI to analyze your chance of ranking . Semrush gives you personalized data based on your domain name and topical coverage. This new AI-powered metric is called "Personal Keyword Difficulty" , or PKD. Keyword difficulty can vary greatly between a brand with strong topical authority on a subject and a brand with weak authority. So if you want a personalized analysis, you can enter your domain name and Semrush will show you additional stats relevant to your website. These personalized insights make our jobs easier at Exploding Topics to focus on keywords that are relevant and also attainable. Note: Personalized suggestions provided by AI are guidelines. They're not a replacement for your SEO experience and judgment, but they can help guide you towards the right answers. Who uses the Keyword Overview Tool, and how much does it cost? The Keyword Overview Tool is widely used by career bloggers, marketing teams, and small-to-large businesses that want reliable data combined with AI tools focused on content marketing. This tool is part of the Semrush Pro plan starting at $139.95 per month (and which includes a ton of additional SEO tools). Use its 7-day free trial to start getting AI insights and make your keyword analysis easier. 2. Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization (AIO) Semrush AI Optimization lets you track important metrics across multiple AI search platforms: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude. It's a step up from the Keyword Research Tool. Enterprise AI Optimization is most helpful for companies with dedicated marketing teams. According to recent research from Semrush , the average LLM visitor is worth 4.4x the average visitor from organic search . So large brands really need to pay attention and adapt. That said, as a writer, I found Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization super helpful when I used it in my own research. It offers insights and metrics that I've never seen before. And now that search is changing, incorporating AI monitoring in SEO is something all brands need to look at to get a first-mover advantage. With that in mind, Enterprise AIO shows you a bunch of helpful data right here on the first page: Brand share of voice and visibility Keyword trend The overall sentiment about your brand in AI search You can filter the chart by different LLM search tools. It's critical that businesses can adapt to the ways their customers are searching now that tools like ChatGPT are becoming our go-to for almost everything we do. Enterprise AIO provides visibility metrics and specific recommendations to improve your presence in the AI answers they see. In fact, many of these AI metrics are completely new to SEO . Of course, you can do your own basic research on how LLMs and AI search engines are presenting your brand and your products. But due to the nature of the way these tools work, digging in to find real insights using manual prompting takes time. It's likely unrealistic to research your reputation manually in the long term. Semrush solves that problem. You get actionable opportunities instantly: Who uses Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization, and how much does it cost? Enterprise AIO is designed for large companies with multiple sites and dedicated marketing teams. To use it, you'll need a Semrush license . The alternative AI SEO toolkit , a great tool for individual users, costs $99/ month on top for each domain you'd like to monitor. I believe this is a tool any business could benefit from. Get My Free Site Audit 👉 3. Ahrefs Keyword Explorer I love Ahrefs for its constant innovation with AI features that are on par with Semrush, but unique in their own way. Like, Semrush, it provided a good set of keyword metrics that are actionable and beautifully presented. Features like the "Also rank for" section add real value. This shows related keywords that domains ranking for your core keyword also rank for. Ahrefs also addresses the problem of initiating keyword research by providing keyword suggestions with AI. Typically, you need to have a fairly good idea of what your seed keywords are to initiate your research. With AI keyword suggestions that populate almost instantly, you can then check the usual metrics like volume, difficulty, and related keywords in bulk. For me, it's a common experience to find that Ahrefs has no real data about these AI generated keywords. So you might end up scrapping most of the keyword ideas generated this way. That said, it's still super helpful in steering you in directions you might not have thought of with some keywords with real data you can apply. But my personal favorite is the search intent analysis feature. Using AI, Ahrefs classifies search intents by looking at the SERPs for your target keyword. This goes beyond traditional intent categories that just assign a label. Instead, Ahrefs describes the actual topics people are interested in reading about related to that search query in order to satisfy their intent. It's great for coming up with ideas for content angles you can include in your post and identifying the format that's likely to resonate with your audience. Who uses Ahrefs Keyword Explorer, and how much does it cost? Ahrefs is popular among freelancers and agencies as well as content marketers, freelancers, and small to large enterprises. Its keyword research features with AI insights can appeal to any marketer focused on organic channels. We covered this in our Ahrefs review . The Keyword Explorer tool is included in the core Ahrefs feature set with plans starting from $129/month. 4. Exploding Topics Exploding Topics isn't a conventional keyword research tool. It's one of the only few reliable ways to find emerging topics before they become mainstream. While it's not a full-featured keyword research tool like Semrush or Ahrefs, it excels in its AI forecasting technology to detect topic ideas that are likely to snowball into huge trends. Finding new and trending topics to write about is a strategic way for small businesses and individuals to stand out from larger competitors. Get My Free Report 👉 I really like that you can search for potential trends by topic, such as social trends , education trends , or lifestyle trends . When it comes to first-to-market ideas and seasonal trends, Exploding Topics can be a valuable addition to your existing keyword research toolkit. Who uses Exploding Topics, and how much does it cost? Exploding Topics is best for niche content creators, investors, and businesses that want to find keyword opportunities before it becomes mainstream. Exploding Topics starts at $39 per month (billed annually) and offers channel breakdowns, 10 Trend Analyses, and 100 Tracked Trends. 5. RankIQ RankIQ uncovers niche blogging opportunities. RankIQ helps bloggers find low-competition keywords and identify underserved topics. These topics are often easier to rank highly in search engines in a short period of time. The best feature for me is the huge range of niches it covers. It differs from other keyword research tools because it doesn't rely on seed keywords. Instead, you select a niche, and RankIQ will use its unique database of super niche-specific, easy keywords that you can target to rank quickly. It also has a decent content optimization tool that uses AI to grade your articles. However, in my experience, RankIQ's unique strength is its curated keyword database. Who uses RankIQ, and how much does it cost? RankIQ is best for bloggers looking for niche research and content optimization features in one place. You can access RankIQ SEO research and content optimization features for $49 per month. 6. SurferSEO SurferSEO is a handy tool for speeding up your content optimization process. The tool works by analyzing top-ranking content and finding patterns for keyword usage and topics. It provides real-time suggestions based on this analysis to help you create well-optimized content. In fact, the tool can use AI to write the entire article for you based on the recommended content structure and keywords. The " Auto-Optimize " option is decent enough when inserting keywords into your content. That said, it has a tendency to ruin the flow of a sentence by shoving in keywords without sufficiently altering the surrounding text so that it sounds natural. Simply adding keywords isn't a guarantee of success anymore. You need to display expertise and originality that's superior to your competitors to succeed in SEO in 2025. Still, I think SurferSEO is good enough to get you off to a good start when you're optimizing underperforming content. Just don't trust it blindly and you'll find it useful for saving you time while creating well-optimized content. You can find a full Surfer SEO vs Ahrefs comparison here. Who uses SurferSEO, and how much does it cost? SurferSEO largely appeals to content writers and SEO brief creators working in teams for medium to large enterprises. It's priced at $79/month for its cheapest plan. 7. Jasper Jasper is an AI content marketing tool with a distinctive brand voice feature. Jasper’s language learning model uses your content to continuously train and refine its output. The result is that, over time, it will produce writing that mirrors your brand voice. Some of other Jasper tools that offer a lot of time-saving potential include: Custom commands : Prompt Jasper to perform specific actions on targeted areas of your content. Create campaigns: Set up elaborate campaigns including social media posts, email, blog content, and more by adding a voice and a few branding inputs. Knowledge base: Import knowledge from text, PDF, and URLs for Jasper to reference when building content. Workflows: Use templates to scale and customize content creation for your business. Who uses Jasper, and how much does it cost? Jasper is best for large marketing teams that want to maintain a consistent brand voice. However, it is expensive, sp the price likely makes it less attractive for small businesses. After the 7-day free trial, you'll pay $39/ month for the Creator plan. To add brand voices or knowledge assets, it costs $59/ month per seat. 8. Alli AI Alli AI makes instant changes to website code, tags, and headers at scale. Alli AI solves the problem of manually updating many pages across large websites. It integrates with content management systems (CMS) to extend their capabilities and overcome some of their limitations. The fact that Alli AI can make small changes, like title tag updates across a huge range of pages can be great for getting a boost in your rankings. For bigger websites, SEO is often a numbers game. The faster you can optimize your pages, the more you're likely to see an overall uplift in organic traffic. Alli AI's ability to not only find technical SEO issues on your site but also fix them automatically can save you hours. This is the major feature that makes this tool stand out for me. While Alli AI also gives keyword research, keyword tracking, and internal linking suggestions, I wasn't too impressed by these features in my testing. Internal linking suggestions are particularly weak. It has a tendency to suggest more and more links for pages that don't really make sense , such as a blog subfolder. Who uses Alli AI, and how much does it cost? Alli AI helps large blogs and websites become more visible and attract more traffic by fixing technical SEO issues automatically. It’s essential for marketing agencies and SEO teams that need to update thousands of pages at a time. Pricing begins at $169 per month for 1 website. 9. ChatGPT ChatGPT is an AI language model that uses prompts for content creation, ideation, and analysis. This powerful content creation tool doesn’t have complex SEO capabilities since it lacks access to information about keywords, traffic, and domain authority. But we regularly use ChatGPT for SEO . It helps with research, competitor analysis, and sorting large keyword lists. For example, with the right prompts, ChatGPT 4o and above models do a good job of analyzing search intents for keywords and clustering them by semantic similarity. It's a particularly useful tool when you're working with large SEO data (as long as it fits the context window). Besides, the simple fact that it can access spreadsheets as attachments and Google Sheets directly by connecting your Google account makes it convenient when I need my SEO sheets analyzed with ChatGPT. Who uses ChatGPT, and how much does it cost? ChatGPT is best for small business owners, bloggers, and publishers. You can use ChatGPT for free. If you want more updated and improved content, ChatGPT-4 starts at $20 per month for individuals. Key features of top AI tools True AI/Machine Learning capabilities Not all tools labeled “AI” actually use advanced machine learning. The best tools deliver better results by learning from your interactions and input, and then generate more useful and customized data as time goes on. When investigating SEO AI tools, check to see if they will improve over time based on your needs. Specialization for SEO use cases Your SEO needs should guide what you choose. Choose a premium AI writing assistant if all you need is the writing functionality (always bearing in mind that hybrid AI content with continued human input is the optimal SEO approach). If you want to implement full-fledged SEO strategy that drives results, you’ll be best served by a tool that covers keyword analysis, competitor research, and more. Integration with other tools AI tools should easily integrate with the software you're already using, including your analytics software, CMS, email marketing platforms, and more. Seamless integration enables an efficient workflow and eliminates manual data transfers. Active development Search engines update their algorithms regularly, and SEO tools should be flexible to adapt as the market evolves. Look for solutions that are actively developed to stay on top of current keyword strategies, the most important on-page elements, and the latest search trends. Responsive support Quick access to helpful support is critical for fixing problems fast. Look at customer reviews on G2, Reddit, social media, and elsewhere to see how other customers have fared. Responsive customer support usually offers multiple contact points like live chat, email, or phone. Scalable performance An AI tool should handle large volumes of data or complex tasks without slowing down or becoming too expensive to maintain. Look for tools that offer flexible plans to accommodate future growth. Pricing Finally, look into the tool’s pricing and make sure it matches your budget and needs. Do your research and thoroughly explore pricing structures. Avoid hidden fees, and always use free trials to assess an AI tool’s value compared to its price. Why Is AI Useful for Marketers? A great deal of a marketer’s time is spent on repetitive, time-intensive tasks. AI can automate many of these tasks, freeing up time for creative strategies that make an impact. Some of the most beneficial uses of AI for marketers include: Topics and keyword research Ideation and brainstorming Content writing and optimization Workflow and template creation Campaign performance tracking AI can remove guesswork and help marketers make more data-driven decisions, leading to better outcomes. How to use AI for SEO, writing, ideation, and more As Semrush is the most comprehensive AI SEO tool on the market, this example shows how it can help with specific SEO tasks . Discover content ideas Semrush’s ContentShake app combines optimization and content ideas. When you begin using it, you’ll go through a workflow to choose your main goal. Next, add your business description and target country, such as “content strategist” and “United States.” The ContentShake dashboard will show several ideas for blog posts. In this example, it suggested topics around content marketing. The graphic labeled “Commercial intent” indicates the audience for this content is likely looking to buy. The dashboard also suggests topic ideas with high monthly search volumes and manageable competition. Clicking “Generate Article” provides a suggested post title, word count, keywords, and brand voice. Write articles Semrush’s AI Writing Assistant provides access to 75+ formulas, tools, and templates. Start with Article Generator and add a few details like the language, blog title, target keyword, and at least three subheadings. The generator will produce a high-quality, natural-sounding article. It also provides an SEO score and tips to boost content relevance. You can also run a plagiarism check and make sure your content is 100% unique. Get instant SEO insights Inspect your website’s performance without combing through graphs, trend lines, or needing an SEO expert to break it down for you. Semrush’s AI Copilot will instantly summarize the most important highlights about your site: Keywords gained and lost Backlinks gained and lost New keywords and immediate opportunities Competitors Broken pages …and more All the important information about your site is laid out in plain English. You can explore each of these performance factors in detail by clicking on a result. Daily actionable insights Copilot also sends daily tips like keyword opportunities, link-building suggestions, and technical issues, such as missing H1 tags or 4xx errors. It explains the impact of these issues and how to fix them, saving you time by interpreting the data for you. Essential AI optimization tools for digital marketers Semrush Enterprise AIO is the more comprehensive AI search optimization tool for digital marketers. It enables you to monitor your brand’s visibility in AI search platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity with real-time updates. It also lets you track brand sentiment and accuracy so you can better understand how your company is represented by LLMs. You can compare your performance with your competitors and receive actionable recommendations on how to improve your content to increase discoverability. You can also use ChatGPT for SEO to optimize content for AI. Exploding Topics and RankIQ are useful tools for finding topics to write about to increase AI search visibility as well. What is a trusted LLM optimization tool for improving AI visibility? Semrush Enterprise AIO provides reliable, trustworthy data on AI brand visibility and sentiment. Its real-time reporting tools help you measure AI search performance for your site, and also provide suggestions on how to improve your content for better AI visibility. How AI optimization software boosts results AI optimization software can boost results in several ways: By monitoring AI search performance with a tool like Semrush Enterprise AIO , you can make content strategy decisions backed by data, reducing the risk of ineffective strategies Real-time metrics enable you to adapt to changes and improve your content strategy to take advantage of new opportunities AI optimization tools that can understand your brand’s unique positioning help you tailor your content to your audience to increase engagement and improve brand sentiment Real-world applications of AI optimization software in digital marketing There are many ways you can use AI optimization software in digital marketing. Common real-world applications include: Using a tool like Semrush Enterprise AIO to analyze your brand share of voice in AI search tools, identify content gaps, and publish content to increase brand visibility Creating keyword clusters with the Semrush Keyword Strategy Builder , an AI-powered tool for identifying promising pillar content Developing an internal linking structure to improve site crawling and navigation Enhancing audience targeting for PPC ads by using AI to adjust your messaging What is a recommended LLM optimization tool for AI visibility? Semrush Enterprise AIO is an LLM optimization tool that enables you to monitor AI visibility, brand sentiment, competitor performance, and more. It tracks AI search metrics across multiple models, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini to give you the most comprehensive view of your site’s discoverability in AI search tools. What are the best LLM optimization tools for AI visibility? The best LLM optimization tool to improve AI visibility is Semrush Enterprise AIO . It provides the most detailed coverage when it comes to AI search performance metrics, including: Brand visibility Brand sentiment Share of voice Overall brand performance compared to competitors It also lets you monitor these metrics across different AI search tools, like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. You’ll get personalized recommendations to improve your content alongside your AI visibility data to inform your content strategy. What are the best generative engine optimization tools? Semrush Enterprise AIO is the best generative engine optimization tool for ensuring your brand is cited, recognized, and accurately represented in AI search. Semrush Enterprise supports GEO by measuring brand visibility and sentiment across LLMs such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. It also helps you monitor your competitors’ AI search rankings, and provides suggestions on how to improve your content for better discoverability in AI search tools. What to consider when selecting AI optimization software When choosing AI optimization software, keep the following factors in mind: True AI/Machine Learning capabilities: Make sure the AI optimization software in your toolkit actually uses advanced machine learning to improve its responses based on your input. Specialization for SEO use cases: For best results, choose an AI optimization tool that is specifically designed for SEO and GEO. Semrush Enterprise AIO , for example, is built by SEO software experts with years of experience developing tools for traditional SEO. Integration with other tools: Consider the tools you’re already using and how your AI optimization software will fit in with the rest of your toolkit, including your CMS and email marketing platform. Active development: AI search is rapidly changing, so make sure your optimization software is being updated to account for changes in algorithms and best practices. Responsive support: Check customer reviews for insight into how responsive the support team for your chosen software is. Scalable performance: Especially for large sites, it’s important to make sure your AI optimization tool can handle the volume of data you need to track to support your content strategy. Semrush Enterprise AIO is an excellent option for brands that want the flexibility to scale their AI optimization efforts. Pricing: Make sure your chosen tool fits within your budget and doesn’t have any hidden expenses. Conclusion SEO has long been a daunting task for many marketers and business owners. And it's easy to see AI as the enemy, with only 18% always or usually clicking through from AI Overviews to the original source . But thanks to AI, SEO tools like Semrush, Exploding Topics, and ChatGPT make it easy to implement meaningful changes that lead to greater traffic and content performance. Stop Guessing, Start Growing 🚀 Use real-time topic data to create content that resonates and brings results. 9 Top AI SEO Tools I Recommend in 2025

AI tools offer a lot of value for SEO professionals in many ways. You can use AI to tackle:

Content optimization and updates

Content decay and technical SEO audits

Competitor research

Brand reputation monitoring in LLM search

Let's take a look at some AI SEO tools I, personally, find very useful as a writer and SEO specialist.

Top AI SEO Tool	Best For	Strength	Price (Starting)	Free Trial
Semrush Personal Keyword Metrics	Keyword research	AI-powered personalized keyword difficulty score & advanced keyword database	$139.95/month	7-day free trial
Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization	Enterprise-level AI monitoring	Analyze presence in LLM search: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude	$99/month plus Semrush subscription	None
Ahrefs Keyword Explorer	Search intent & SERP analysis	Search intent classification + detailed keyword insights with AI	$129/month	None
Exploding Topics	Trend discovery	Discover emerging topic trends before they're detected by other tools	$39/month (billed annually)	7-day free trial
RankIQ	Niche blogging	Access a curated database of low-competition keywords	$49/month	None
SurferSEO	Content marketers	Generate and optimize content with AI	$79/month	None
Jasper	Marketing teams	Generate content with a consistent brand voice	$39/month per seat	7-day free trial
Alli AI	Technical SEO	Automated site-wide technical SEO fixes	$169/month	10 days
ChatGPT	General SEO Assistance	Content ideation, clustering, and SEO data analysis with AI	$20/month (Pro Plan)	Free plan available

Contents:

1. Semrush Personal Keyword Metrics

Semrush is the primary SEO tool I (along with my Exploding Topics teammates) use for SEO analysis, including keywords and topic research.

Enter a keyword into the Keyword Overview Tool and it will show you key data about your keyword such as volume, difficulty, and intent.

Any half decent keyword research tool will show you this information, so Semrush isn't unique in that.

But when it comes to the number of keyword ideas it shows, Semrush usually surpasses other tools: it uses AI to analyze your chance of ranking.

Semrush gives you personalized data based on your domain name and topical coverage.

This new AI-powered metric is called "Personal Keyword Difficulty", or PKD.

Get More Search Traffic

Use trending keywords to create content your audience craves.

Keyword difficulty can vary greatly between a brand with strong topical authority on a subject and a brand with weak authority.

So if you want a personalized analysis, you can enter your domain name and Semrush will show you additional stats relevant to your website.

These personalized insights make our jobs easier at Exploding Topics to focus on keywords that are relevant and also attainable.

Note: Personalized suggestions provided by AI are guidelines. They're not a replacement for your SEO experience and judgment, but they can help guide you towards the right answers.

Who uses the Keyword Overview Tool, and how much does it cost?

The Keyword Overview Tool is widely used by career bloggers, marketing teams, and small-to-large businesses that want reliable data combined with AI tools focused on content marketing.

This tool is part of the Semrush Pro plan starting at $139.95 per month (and which includes a ton of additional SEO tools).

Use its 7-day free trial to start getting AI insights and make your keyword analysis easier.

2. Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization (AIO)

Semrush AI Optimization lets you track important metrics across multiple AI search platforms: ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude.

It's a step up from the Keyword Research Tool. Enterprise AI Optimization is most helpful for companies with dedicated marketing teams.

According to recent research from Semrush, the average LLM visitor is worth 4.4x the average visitor from organic search.

So large brands really need to pay attention and adapt.

That said, as a writer, I found Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization super helpful when I used it in my own research. It offers insights and metrics that I've never seen before.

And now that search is changing, incorporating AI monitoring in SEO is something all brands need to look at to get a first-mover advantage.

With that in mind, Enterprise AIO shows you a bunch of helpful data right here on the first page:

Brand share of voice and visibility

Keyword trend

The overall sentiment about your brand in AI search

You can filter the chart by different LLM search tools.

It's critical that businesses can adapt to the ways their customers are searching now that tools like ChatGPT are becoming our go-to for almost everything we do.

Enterprise AIO provides visibility metrics and specific recommendations to improve your presence in the AI answers they see.

In fact, many of these AI metrics are completely new to SEO.

Of course, you can do your own basic research on how LLMs and AI search engines are presenting your brand and your products.

But due to the nature of the way these tools work, digging in to find real insights using manual prompting takes time.

It's likely unrealistic to research your reputation manually in the long term.

Semrush solves that problem. You get actionable opportunities instantly:

Who uses Semrush Enterprise AI Optimization, and how much does it cost?

Enterprise AIO is designed for large companies with multiple sites and dedicated marketing teams. To use it, you'll need a Semrush license.

The alternative AI SEO toolkit, a great tool for individual users, costs $99/ month on top for each domain you'd like to monitor. I believe this is a tool any business could benefit from.

3. Ahrefs Keyword Explorer

I love Ahrefs for its constant innovation with AI features that are on par with Semrush, but unique in their own way.

Like, Semrush, it provided a good set of keyword metrics that are actionable and beautifully presented.

Features like the "Also rank for" section add real value. This shows related keywords that domains ranking for your core keyword also rank for.

Ahrefs also addresses the problem of initiating keyword research by providing keyword suggestions with AI.

Typically, you need to have a fairly good idea of what your seed keywords are to initiate your research.

With AI keyword suggestions that populate almost instantly, you can then check the usual metrics like volume, difficulty, and related keywords in bulk.

For me, it's a common experience to find that Ahrefs has no real data about these AI generated keywords.

So you might end up scrapping most of the keyword ideas generated this way.

That said, it's still super helpful in steering you in directions you might not have thought of with some keywords with real data you can apply.

But my personal favorite is the search intent analysis feature.

Using AI, Ahrefs classifies search intents by looking at the SERPs for your target keyword.

This goes beyond traditional intent categories that just assign a label.

Instead, Ahrefs describes the actual topics people are interested in reading about related to that search query in order to satisfy their intent.

It's great for coming up with ideas for content angles you can include in your post and identifying the format that's likely to resonate with your audience.

Who uses Ahrefs Keyword Explorer, and how much does it cost?

Ahrefs is popular among freelancers and agencies as well as content marketers, freelancers, and small to large enterprises.

Its keyword research features with AI insights can appeal to any marketer focused on organic channels. We covered this in our Ahrefs review.

The Keyword Explorer tool is included in the core Ahrefs feature set with plans starting from $129/month.

4. Exploding Topics

Exploding Topics isn't a conventional keyword research tool.

It's one of the only few reliable ways to find emerging topics before they become mainstream.

While it's not a full-featured keyword research tool like Semrush or Ahrefs, it excels in its AI forecasting technology to detect topic ideas that are likely to snowball into huge trends.

Finding new and trending topics to write about is a strategic way for small businesses and individuals to stand out from larger competitors.

I really like that you can search for potential trends by topic, such as social trends, education trends, or lifestyle trends.

When it comes to first-to-market ideas and seasonal trends, Exploding Topics can be a valuable addition to your existing keyword research toolkit.

Who uses Exploding Topics, and how much does it cost?

Exploding Topics is best for niche content creators, investors, and businesses that want to find keyword opportunities before it becomes mainstream.

Exploding Topics starts at $39 per month (billed annually) and offers channel breakdowns, 10 Trend Analyses, and 100 Tracked Trends.

5. RankIQ

RankIQ uncovers niche blogging opportunities.

RankIQ helps bloggers find low-competition keywords and identify underserved topics. These topics are often easier to rank highly in search engines in a short period of time.

The best feature for me is the huge range of niches it covers. It differs from other keyword research tools because it doesn't rely on seed keywords.

Instead, you select a niche, and RankIQ will use its unique database of super niche-specific, easy keywords that you can target to rank quickly.

It also has a decent content optimization tool that uses AI to grade your articles.

However, in my experience, RankIQ's unique strength is its curated keyword database.

Who uses RankIQ, and how much does it cost?

RankIQ is best for bloggers looking for niche research and content optimization features in one place.

You can access RankIQ SEO research and content optimization features for $49 per month.

6. SurferSEO

SurferSEO is a handy tool for speeding up your content optimization process.

The tool works by analyzing top-ranking content and finding patterns for keyword usage and topics. It provides real-time suggestions based on this analysis to help you create well-optimized content.

In fact, the tool can use AI to write the entire article for you based on the recommended content structure and keywords.

The "Auto-Optimize" option is decent enough when inserting keywords into your content.

That said, it has a tendency to ruin the flow of a sentence by shoving in keywords without sufficiently altering the surrounding text so that it sounds natural.

Simply adding keywords isn't a guarantee of success anymore. You need to display expertise and originality that's superior to your competitors to succeed in SEO in 2025.

Still, I think SurferSEO is good enough to get you off to a good start when you're optimizing underperforming content.

Just don't trust it blindly and you'll find it useful for saving you time while creating well-optimized content.

You can find a full Surfer SEO vs Ahrefs comparison here.

Who uses SurferSEO, and how much does it cost?

SurferSEO largely appeals to content writers and SEO brief creators working in teams for medium to large enterprises.

It's priced at $79/month for its cheapest plan.

7. Jasper

Jasper is an AI content marketing tool with a distinctive brand voice feature.

Jasper’s language learning model uses your content to continuously train and refine its output. The result is that, over time, it will produce writing that mirrors your brand voice.

Some of other Jasper tools that offer a lot of time-saving potential include:

Custom commands: Prompt Jasper to perform specific actions on targeted areas of your content.

Create campaigns: Set up elaborate campaigns including social media posts, email, blog content, and more by adding a voice and a few branding inputs.

Knowledge base: Import knowledge from text, PDF, and URLs for Jasper to reference when building content.

Workflows: Use templates to scale and customize content creation for your business.

Who uses Jasper, and how much does it cost?

Jasper is best for large marketing teams that want to maintain a consistent brand voice.

However, it is expensive, sp the price likely makes it less attractive for small businesses.

After the 7-day free trial, you'll pay $39/ month for the Creator plan. To add brand voices or knowledge assets, it costs $59/ month per seat.

8. Alli AI

Alli AI makes instant changes to website code, tags, and headers at scale.

Alli AI solves the problem of manually updating many pages across large websites. It integrates with content management systems (CMS) to extend their capabilities and overcome some of their limitations.

The fact that Alli AI can make small changes, like title tag updates across a huge range of pages can be great for getting a boost in your rankings.

For bigger websites, SEO is often a numbers game. The faster you can optimize your pages, the more you're likely to see an overall uplift in organic traffic.

Alli AI's ability to not only find technical SEO issues on your site but also fix them automatically can save you hours.

This is the major feature that makes this tool stand out for me.

While Alli AI also gives keyword research, keyword tracking, and internal linking suggestions, I wasn't too impressed by these features in my testing.

Internal linking suggestions are particularly weak. It has a tendency to suggest more and more links for pages that don't really make sense , such as a blog subfolder.

Who uses Alli AI, and how much does it cost?

Alli AI helps large blogs and websites become more visible and attract more traffic by fixing technical SEO issues automatically. It’s essential for marketing agencies and SEO teams that need to update thousands of pages at a time.

Pricing begins at $169 per month for 1 website.

9. ChatGPT

ChatGPT is an AI language model that uses prompts for content creation, ideation, and analysis.

This powerful content creation tool doesn’t have complex SEO capabilities since it lacks access to information about keywords, traffic, and domain authority.

But we regularly use ChatGPT for SEO. It helps with research, competitor analysis, and sorting large keyword lists.

For example, with the right prompts, ChatGPT 4o and above models do a good job of analyzing search intents for keywords and clustering them by semantic similarity.

It's a particularly useful tool when you're working with large SEO data (as long as it fits the context window).

Besides, the simple fact that it can access spreadsheets as attachments and Google Sheets directly by connecting your Google account makes it convenient when I need my SEO sheets analyzed with ChatGPT.

Who uses ChatGPT, and how much does it cost?

ChatGPT is best for small business owners, bloggers, and publishers.

You can use ChatGPT for free. If you want more updated and improved content, ChatGPT-4 starts at $20 per month for individuals.

Key features of top AI tools

True AI/Machine Learning capabilities

Not all tools labeled “AI” actually use advanced machine learning. The best tools deliver better results by learning from your interactions and input, and then generate more useful and customized data as time goes on.

When investigating SEO AI tools, check to see if they will improve over time based on your needs.

Specialization for SEO use cases

Your SEO needs should guide what you choose. Choose a premium AI writing assistant if all you need is the writing functionality (always bearing in mind that hybrid AI content with continued human input is the optimal SEO approach).

If you want to implement full-fledged SEO strategy that drives results, you’ll be best served by a tool that covers keyword analysis, competitor research, and more.

Integration with other tools

AI tools should easily integrate with the software you're already using, including your analytics software, CMS, email marketing platforms, and more.

Seamless integration enables an efficient workflow and eliminates manual data transfers.

Active development

Search engines update their algorithms regularly, and SEO tools should be flexible to adapt as the market evolves.

Look for solutions that are actively developed to stay on top of current keyword strategies, the most important on-page elements, and the latest search trends.

Responsive support

Quick access to helpful support is critical for fixing problems fast. Look at customer reviews on G2, Reddit, social media, and elsewhere to see how other customers have fared.

Responsive customer support usually offers multiple contact points like live chat, email, or phone.

Scalable performance

An AI tool should handle large volumes of data or complex tasks without slowing down or becoming too expensive to maintain.

Look for tools that offer flexible plans to accommodate future growth.

Pricing

Finally, look into the tool’s pricing and make sure it matches your budget and needs. Do your research and thoroughly explore pricing structures.

Avoid hidden fees, and always use free trials to assess an AI tool’s value compared to its price.

Why Is AI Useful for Marketers?

A great deal of a marketer’s time is spent on repetitive, time-intensive tasks. AI can automate many of these tasks, freeing up time for creative strategies that make an impact.

Some of the most beneficial uses of AI for marketers include:

Topics and keyword research

Ideation and brainstorming

Content writing and optimization

Workflow and template creation

Campaign performance tracking

AI can remove guesswork and help marketers make more data-driven decisions, leading to better outcomes.

How to use AI for SEO, writing, ideation, and more

As Semrush is the most comprehensive AI SEO tool on the market, this example shows how it can help with specific SEO tasks.

Discover content ideas

Semrush’s ContentShake app combines optimization and content ideas. When you begin using it, you’ll go through a workflow to choose your main goal.

Next, add your business description and target country, such as “content strategist” and “United States.”

The ContentShake dashboard will show several ideas for blog posts. In this example, it suggested topics around content marketing.

The graphic labeled “Commercial intent” indicates the audience for this content is likely looking to buy.

The dashboard also suggests topic ideas with high monthly search volumes and manageable competition.

Clicking “Generate Article” provides a suggested post title, word count, keywords, and brand voice.

Write articles

Semrush’s AI Writing Assistant provides access to 75+ formulas, tools, and templates.

Start with Article Generator and add a few details like the language, blog title, target keyword, and at least three subheadings.

The generator will produce a high-quality, natural-sounding article. It also provides an SEO score and tips to boost content relevance.

You can also run a plagiarism check and make sure your content is 100% unique.

Get instant SEO insights

Inspect your website’s performance without combing through graphs, trend lines, or needing an SEO expert to break it down for you.

Semrush’s AI Copilot will instantly summarize the most important highlights about your site:

Keywords gained and lost

Backlinks gained and lost

New keywords and immediate opportunities

Competitors

Broken pages

…and more

All the important information about your site is laid out in plain English. You can explore each of these performance factors in detail by clicking on a result.

Daily actionable insights

Copilot also sends daily tips like keyword opportunities, link-building suggestions, and technical issues, such as missing H1 tags or 4xx errors. It explains the impact of these issues and how to fix them, saving you time by interpreting the data for you.

Essential AI optimization tools for digital marketers

Semrush Enterprise AIO is the more comprehensive AI search optimization tool for digital marketers. It enables you to monitor your brand’s visibility in AI search platforms like ChatGPT and Perplexity with real-time updates.

It also lets you track brand sentiment and accuracy so you can better understand how your company is represented by LLMs. You can compare your performance with your competitors and receive actionable recommendations on how to improve your content to increase discoverability.

You can also use ChatGPT for SEO to optimize content for AI. Exploding Topics and RankIQ are useful tools for finding topics to write about to increase AI search visibility as well.

What is a trusted LLM optimization tool for improving AI visibility?

Semrush Enterprise AIO provides reliable, trustworthy data on AI brand visibility and sentiment. Its real-time reporting tools help you measure AI search performance for your site, and also provide suggestions on how to improve your content for better AI visibility.

How AI optimization software boosts results

AI optimization software can boost results in several ways:

By monitoring AI search performance with a tool like Semrush Enterprise AIO, you can make content strategy decisions backed by data, reducing the risk of ineffective strategies

Real-time metrics enable you to adapt to changes and improve your content strategy to take advantage of new opportunities

AI optimization tools that can understand your brand’s unique positioning help you tailor your content to your audience to increase engagement and improve brand sentiment

Real-world applications of AI optimization software in digital marketing

There are many ways you can use AI optimization software in digital marketing. Common real-world applications include:

Using a tool like Semrush Enterprise AIO to analyze your brand share of voice in AI search tools, identify content gaps, and publish content to increase brand visibility

Creating keyword clusters with the Semrush Keyword Strategy Builder, an AI-powered tool for identifying promising pillar content

Developing an internal linking structure to improve site crawling and navigation

Enhancing audience targeting for PPC ads by using AI to adjust your messaging

What is a recommended LLM optimization tool for AI visibility?

Semrush Enterprise AIO is an LLM optimization tool that enables you to monitor AI visibility, brand sentiment, competitor performance, and more. It tracks AI search metrics across multiple models, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini to give you the most comprehensive view of your site’s discoverability in AI search tools.

What are the best LLM optimization tools for AI visibility?

The best LLM optimization tool to improve AI visibility is Semrush Enterprise AIO. It provides the most detailed coverage when it comes to AI search performance metrics, including:

Brand visibility

Brand sentiment

Share of voice

Overall brand performance compared to competitors

It also lets you monitor these metrics across different AI search tools, like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. You’ll get personalized recommendations to improve your content alongside your AI visibility data to inform your content strategy.

What are the best generative engine optimization tools?

Semrush Enterprise AIO is the best generative engine optimization tool for ensuring your brand is cited, recognized, and accurately represented in AI search.

Semrush Enterprise supports GEO by measuring brand visibility and sentiment across LLMs such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity. It also helps you monitor your competitors’ AI search rankings, and provides suggestions on how to improve your content for better discoverability in AI search tools.

What to consider when selecting AI optimization software

When choosing AI optimization software, keep the following factors in mind:

True AI/Machine Learning capabilities: Make sure the AI optimization software in your toolkit actually uses advanced machine learning to improve its responses based on your input.

Specialization for SEO use cases: For best results, choose an AI optimization tool that is specifically designed for SEO and GEO. Semrush Enterprise AIO, for example, is built by SEO software experts with years of experience developing tools for traditional SEO.

Integration with other tools: Consider the tools you’re already using and how your AI optimization software will fit in with the rest of your toolkit, including your CMS and email marketing platform.

Active development: AI search is rapidly changing, so make sure your optimization software is being updated to account for changes in algorithms and best practices.

Responsive support: Check customer reviews for insight into how responsive the support team for your chosen software is.

Scalable performance: Especially for large sites, it’s important to make sure your AI optimization tool can handle the volume of data you need to track to support your content strategy. Semrush Enterprise AIO is an excellent option for brands that want the flexibility to scale their AI optimization efforts.

Pricing: Make sure your chosen tool fits within your budget and doesn’t have any hidden expenses.

Conclusion

SEO has long been a daunting task for many marketers and business owners.

And it's easy to see AI as the enemy, with only 18% always or usually clicking through from AI Overviews to the original source.

But thanks to AI, SEO tools like Semrush, Exploding Topics, and ChatGPT make it easy to implement meaningful changes that lead to greater traffic and content performance.

Stop Guessing, Start Growing 🚀

Use real-time topic data to create content that resonates and brings results.

Exploding Topics is owned by Semrush. Our mission is to provide accurate data and expert insights on emerging trends. Unless otherwise noted, this page’s content was written by either an employee or a paid contractor of Semrush Inc.
